title: Man Practicing Fly Fishing in Suburban Street, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white 1950s snapshot showing a man standing in a residential street practicing his fly casting with a fishing rod. A woman in a dress and glasses stands nearby on the right watching him. In the background, a modest post-war single-story suburban house sits beside a paved street lined with utility poles and distant mountains under a bright sky.
